claims.assertion: Tiamat’s destruction shifted solar-system orbits; Saturn captured debris that formed its rings.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: She says Saturn’s moons host colonies and relay stations for many species; the region passed from Sauroid to Federation-aligned control.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: Saturn’s rings are mined for essential metals, especially gold, and support passing-ship resupply.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: Swaruu 9 says a destroyed 5-km Sauroid cube once served as a Saturn-region base; Saturn itself is not inherently evil.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: She says natural portals occur on every celestial body; artificial portals can strand users if exit control is lost.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

review_flags: Regional Sauroid control is distinct from Saturn itself; source dates its end to 2012.
